prompt_md: 5 ranked pirates split 100 coins. The senior proposes; with at least half voting yes (proposer included) it passes, else the plank and the next proposes. All are logical, greedy, and vote no when indifferent. Senior's share?
prompt_short: 5 ranked pirates, 100 coins, majority vote or overboard. Senior pirate's share?
explain_intuition_md: With two pirates, the senior keeps everything: their own vote is half. With three, the senior buys the most junior with 1 coin. Working up the same way, the senior of five needs two votes besides their own and buys them for 1 coin each from the two pirates who would get nothing otherwise. That leaves 98.
